from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company from a single 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company, as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the filing covers, e.g., 'Q1 2025' or 'March 31, 2025'")
    consolidated_net_income: float | None = Field(description="The consolidated net income or loss amount (negative if loss)")
    consolidated_net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities (can be negative if 'used in')")
    financing_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
